commercial settings.

## What is Photobiomodulation and how it works

Photobiomodulation (PBM)—often referred to as red light therapy—uses specific red and near-infrared
wavelengths (typically 633–1074nm) to support cellular performance and recovery mechanisms, without
heat, pain, or downtime.

Cellular energy (ATP)

Light energy is absorbed by cellular chromophores—primarily within mitochondria—supporting efficient
ATP production, signaling, and performance pathways.

Non-thermal, repeatable protocols

PBM is non-invasive and non-thermal. Outcomes depend on wavelength, irradiance, and exposure time—so
systems must deliver controlled, uniform full-body distribution.

How it works: a 4-layer biological cascade

This is a simplified educational model of how red light therapy (PBM) can translate photons into
cellular and systemic responses.

Therapeutic wavelength range
660nm
810nm
830nm
860nm
940nm
1074nm
Layer 1 — Light entry & optical interaction
* • Selective penetration through epidermis, dermis, and deeper tissues (wavelength dependent).
* • Chromophore absorption: cytochrome c oxidase, porphyrins, water clusters, opsins.
Layer 2 — Bioenergetic conversion (mitochondrial shift)
* • Near-infrared light may release nitric oxide (NO) blockade in respiration.
* • Electron flow and oxygen efficiency improve → ATP output rises.
* • NO supports microvascular flow via vasodilation.
Layer 3 — Cellular remodeling & biological response
* • Structural repair signaling (collagen, elastin, fibroblast activity).
* • Inflammatory modulation and oxidative stress balance.
* • Neurological support and synaptic efficiency.
Layer 4 — System integration & balance
* • Circadian and biological rhythm support.
* • Enhanced mind-body performance and recovery.
* • Improved cellular communication and coherence.

Effects vary by protocol, wavelength selection, and individual factors.

## Clinically studied applications

Peer-reviewed studies have examined photobiomodulation (red light therapy) for skin health,
recovery, pain modulation, and neurological support — and medical-grade therapy beds enable these
applications to be delivered as protocol-based services in clinical and performance settings.

Skin Health & Rejuvenation

Supports collagen production, tone, and clarity.

Pain & Inflammation Support

Helps modulate inflammatory pathways and discomfort.

Muscle Recovery & Performance

Enhances post-exercise recovery and resilience.

Cognitive & Neurological Support

Near-infrared light linked to cerebral blood flow pathways.

Circulation & Tissue Repair

Supports microcirculation and tissue regeneration pathways.

Longevity & Vitality

Energises mitochondrial health and sustains the body at its biological best.

PBM is supported by over 7,000 scientific publications, including 700+ human clinical trials across
dermatology, sports recovery, neurology, and pain therapy.

Devices purchased on our website or through official partners come with a 1-year warranty and can be

## La photobiomodulation
## (PBM)

La PBM agit principalement au niveau des mitochondries des cellules, favorisant la production d’ATP,
une molécule énergétique essentielle, et activant divers mécanismes de réparation cellulaire et de
croissance tissulaire.

## Les technologies
## Milta

Le dispositif Milta intègre des technologies de pointe, comme le laser froid nano-pulsé et des LED.
Ces technologies favorisent une application efficace de la photobiomodulation, améliorant les
résultats obtenus lors des séances. Milta continue de se démarquer par son innovation constante,
fusionnant des avancées technologiques pour renforcer les capacités de ses dispositifs.

## applications
## de la photobiomodulation

La photobiomodulation offre une gamme étendue d’applications, notamment dans la diminution de
l’inflammation et la régénération tissulaire. Le dispositif Milta est utilisé dans diverses
situations professionnelles pour soutenir ces processus, adaptant ses fonctions pour répondre à des
besoins spécifiques en matière de soins et de récupération.

### **Soins support**

Aide à gérer la douleur et favorise la cicatrisation pour un soutien continu.

### **Esthétique**

Améliore l’apparence de la peau, réduit les rides et augmente l’élasticité.

### **Gynécologique**

Soutient les conditions gynécologiques avec une approche non invasive pour le bien-être féminin.

### **Médecine du sport**

Accélère la récupération des blessures et améliore la performance sportive.

### ****Dentisterie****

Favorise la cicatrisation et réduit l’inconfort après les interventions dentaires.

### ****Science du cheveu****

Stimule la croissance des cheveux et améliore la santé du cuir chevelu.

#### Photon Penetration

Near-infrared wavelength — specifically selected for optimal tissue penetration — passes through
scalp and skull to reach targeted cortical regions without heating tissue.

2

#### Mitochondrial Activation

Photons are absorbed by cytochrome c oxidase (CCO) in neuronal mitochondria, triggering enhanced ATP
production, reduced oxidative stress, and restored cellular energy metabolism.

3

#### Cerebral Blood Flow Modulation

Dose-dependent changes in regional cerebral blood flow are confirmed by BOLD fMRI. Effects extend
globally — beyond directly irradiated regions — via neural network connectivity.

4

#### Metabolic Enhancement & Neuroplasticity

FDG-PET imaging confirms increased glucose uptake in prefrontal cortex. Enhanced synaptic function
and neuronal connectivity in mood-regulating circuits support lasting clinical benefit.

Clinical Validation

Harvard/MGH, NYU, and international sites — producing results that exceed existing neuromodulation

## What is Photobiomodulation and how it works

Photobiomodulation (PBM)—often referred to as red light therapy—uses specific red and near-infrared
wavelengths (typically 633–1074nm) to support cellular performance and recovery mechanisms, without
heat, pain, or downtime.

Cellular energy (ATP)

Light energy is absorbed by cellular chromophores—primarily within mitochondria—supporting efficient
ATP production, signaling, and performance pathways.

Non-thermal, repeatable protocols

PBM is non-invasive and non-thermal. Outcomes depend on wavelength, irradiance, and exposure time—so
systems must deliver controlled, uniform full-body distribution.

How it works: a 4-layer biological cascade

This is a simplified educational model of how red light therapy (PBM) can translate photons into
cellular and systemic responses.

Therapeutic wavelength range
660nm
810nm
830nm
860nm
940nm
1074nm
Layer 1 — Light entry & optical interaction
* • Selective penetration through epidermis, dermis, and deeper tissues (wavelength dependent).
* • Chromophore absorption: cytochrome c oxidase, porphyrins, water clusters, opsins.
Layer 2 — Bioenergetic conversion (mitochondrial shift)
* • Near-infrared light may release nitric oxide (NO) blockade in respiration.
* • Electron flow and oxygen efficiency improve → ATP output rises.
* • NO supports microvascular flow via vasodilation.
Layer 3 — Cellular remodeling & biological response
* • Structural repair signaling (collagen, elastin, fibroblast activity).
* • Inflammatory modulation and oxidative stress balance.
* • Neurological support and synaptic efficiency.
Layer 4 — System integration & balance
* • Circadian and biological rhythm support.
* • Enhanced mind-body performance and recovery.
* • Improved cellular communication and coherence.

Effects vary by protocol, wavelength selection, and individual factors.

## Clinically studied applications

Peer-reviewed studies have examined photobiomodulation (red light therapy) for skin health,
recovery, pain modulation, and neurological support — and medical-grade therapy beds enable these
applications to be delivered as protocol-based services in clinical and performance settings.

Skin Health & Rejuvenation

Supports collagen production, tone, and clarity.

Pain & Inflammation Support

Helps modulate inflammatory pathways and discomfort.

Muscle Recovery & Performance

Enhances post-exercise recovery and resilience.

Cognitive & Neurological Support

Near-infrared light linked to cerebral blood flow pathways.

Circulation & Tissue Repair

Supports microcirculation and tissue regeneration pathways.

Longevity & Vitality

Energises mitochondrial health and sustains the body at its biological best.

PBM is supported by over 7,000 scientific publications, including 700+ human clinical trials across
dermatology, sports recovery, neurology, and pain therapy.

## FAQ

## Questions fréquentes

### Qu'est-ce qu'une section FAQ?

Une section FAQ peut être utilisée pour répondre rapidement aux questions fréquemment posées sur
votre entreprise. Par exemple, «Proposez-vous la livraison?», «Quelles sont vos heures
d'ouverture?», «Comment puis-je réserver un service?».

### Pourquoi les FAQ sont-elles importantes?

Les FAQ sont un excellent moyen d'aider les visiteurs à trouver rapidement des réponses aux
questions courantes sur votre entreprise et de créer une meilleure expérience de navigation sur
votre site.

### Où puis-je ajouter mes FAQ?

Les FAQ peuvent être ajoutées à n'importe quelle page de votre site ou sur votre appli mobile Wix.

### Comment puis-je ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse?

Pour ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse, suivez ces étapes:

1. Depuis le tableau de bord ou l'Éditeur, cliquez sur le bouton «Gérer la FAQ».

2. Cliquez sur «Ajouter», puis sélectionnez «Question/Réponse».

3. Choisissez une catégorie pour votre question/réponse.

4. Enregistrez et publiez.


Vous pouvez modifier votre FAQ à tout moment.

### Puis-je ajouter une image, une vidéo ou un GIF à ma FAQ?

Oui. Pour ajouter un média, suivez ces étapes:

1. Depuis le tableau de bord ou l'Éditeur, cliquez sur le bouton «Gérer la FAQ».

2. Créez une nouvelle question/réponse ou modifiez-en une existante.

3. Dans la zone de texte de la réponse, cliquez sur l'icône Vidéo, Image ou GIF.

4. Ajoutez le média depuis votre bibliothèque puis enregistrez.

### Comment puis-je modifier ou retirer le titre «Questions fréquemment posées»?

Depuis l'Éditeur, rendez-vous dans l'onglet «Paramètres» de la FAQ.

Depuis l'appli Wix Owner, rendez-vous dans l'onglet Site et appli.

support you through natural health education, spiritual guidance, and holistic wellness approaches
that help you better understand your body and create balance in ways that feel aligned and
sustainable.

guide and support you through complementary practices such as Reiki, hypnosis for personal growth,
homeopathy, herbal and nutritional guidance, and mind-body-spirit coaching. These offerings are
designed to work alongside licensed medical or psychological care, not replace it. If you have a
medical or mental health concern, I encourage you to seek guidance from a licensed provider.

## About Us

At our Naples, FL-based Brain Rejuvenation Clinic, we specialize in cutting-edge, science-backed
therapies designed to restore and optimize brain health. We incorporate the WAVi Scan System which
allows clinicians to identify early signs of cognitive impairment and tailor treatment protocols to
optimize patient outcomes. Utilizing BAHI Therapy, Hydrogen Inhalation, Photo Biomodulation, and
Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, we activate the body's natural healing processes to enhance cognitive
function and neurological recovery. Our expert team is dedicated to providing personalized,
non-invasive testing and treatments that support brain restoration, mental clarity, and overall
well-being. Experience the future of brain health with innovative therapies that rejuvenate your
mind from the inside out.

At Brain Rejuvenation Clinic of Naples, we pride ourselves on using cutting-edge technology and

# Dalton Brothers

##### O.D. Doctor of Optometry

Brothers Vision Consulting delivers exceptional consultation services backed by a board-certified
optometrist. Our clinician-led sessions are designed to enhance your skills and expertise when
integrating emerging technology into your clinics. Together, we will explore the research that paved
the way for these novel therapies and help improve the communications that leads to better patient
outcomes.

## Areas of Expertise

##### Ocular Aesthetics, Advanced Dry Eye, Regenerative Medicine & Vision Industry Consultation.

[IMG_8555.JPG]

Welcome to Brothers Vision Consulting, where exceptional eye care meets innovative solutions. Led by
Dalton Brothers, O.D., a proud third-generation optometrist, our consultancy is dedicated to
advancing the field of eye care. Dalton graduated from the University of Missouri Saint Louis
College of Optometry in 2019 and has since joined his family's esteemed practice in Joplin,
Missouri. He specializes in ocular aesthetics and dry eye, providing cutting-edge therapies such as
Plate Rich Plasma, Intense Pulsed Light, and Photobiomodulation.

 

In 2021, Dalton expanded his passion for eye care by offering consulting services to fellow
optometrists and ophthalmologists, helping them integrate these advanced therapies into their own
clinics. Our mission is to empower eye care professionals with knowledge and innovative techniques
aimed at enhancing patient outcomes.


Outside of the clinic, Dalton cherishes time spent with his wife and three daughters, bringing a
family-oriented approach to his practice. At Brothers Vision Consulting, we strive to provide the
highest level of care and expertise in every interaction.

Areas of Expertise

## Consultation Services

1

### Advanced InfinityPro LLLT Applications

During these sessions, we will focus on how to implement low level light therapy (LLLT) technology
into your clinic, how to communicate this therapy with staff and patients, and establish a line of
communication for ongoing clinical support for 12 months. Anything I've designed to make my life
easier in clinic will be made available to you as well, including patient handouts, log sheets,
consent forms and much more! 

[More Info ][6]

2

### Advanced Dry Eye Therapies: (IPL + LLLT)

During this training session, we aim to empower providers to confidently implement Intense Pulsed
Light (IPL) and Low Level Light Therapy (LLLT) to enhance both their dry eye and aesthetic outcomes
within their clinics. Our comprehensive training covers crucial aspects, including patient
selection, treatment vs. maintenance care, and effective communication strategies. Additionally, 6
months of ongoing clinical support is also included with this purchase. 

[More Info ][7]

3

### Industry Partner Consultation

Brothers Vision Consulting offers assistance in the publishing of  independent clinical findings,
including research study assessments and protocol design. We offer sponsorships through public
health webinars and podcasts involving, dry eye, aesthetics, and various other applications
regarding the use of diagnostic and therapeutic devices. Through these partnerships, we offer
ongoing strategic guidance for companies within the vision industry.  

[More Info ][8]

Wuhan Cozing Medical Devices Co., Ltd. has been dedicated to the development and manufacturing of
physical therapy laser and light-based devices for nearly a decade in China. Starting as a modest
trading company, we have grown into a leading supplier in the physiotherapy laser and therapeutic
light industry.
Today, Cozing Medical stands as a top-tier professional manufacturer specializing in physiotherapy
lasers and photodynamic therapy devices. Our diverse product portfolio includes Cold Laser Pain
Therapy Devices, Photodynamic Therapy Systems, Laser Hair Regrowth Devices, Vaginal Tightening
Lasers, Parkinson’s Treatment Helmets, and 2-in-1 Sleep Therapy Devices, among others.
Guided by our motto — "Everyone has the right to a healthy life" — we believe that access to quality
physical therapy should be universal, regardless of gender, economic status, or age. That’s why we
are committed to producing affordable and effective physical therapy laser devices, striving to
bring better health and wellness to people worldwide.

Wuhan Cozing Medical Devices Co.,ltd

Wuhan Cozing Medical Devices Co., Ltd. has been dedicated to the development and manufacturing of
physical therapy laser and light-based devices for nearly a decade in China. Starting as a modest
trading company, we have grown into a leading supplier in the physiotherapy laser and therapeutic
light industry.
Today, Cozing Medical stands as a top-tier professional manufacturer specializing in physiotherapy
lasers and photodynamic therapy devices. Our diverse product portfolio includes Cold Laser Pain
Therapy Devices, Photodynamic Therapy Systems, Laser Hair Regrowth Devices, Vaginal Tightening
Lasers, Parkinson’s Treatment Helmets, and 2-in-1 Sleep Therapy Devices, among others.
Guided by our motto — "Everyone has the right to a healthy life" — we believe that access to quality
physical therapy should be universal, regardless of gender, economic status, or age. That’s why we
are committed to producing affordable and effective physical therapy laser devices, striving to
bring better health and wellness to people worldwide.

# Herzlich willkommen bei den Augenpartnern – Ihre Augengesundheit in guten Händen

Als überörtliche Augenarztpraxis zwischen Hamburg, Bremen und Hannover haben wir es uns zum Ziel
gesetzt, Ihnen die beste medizinische Versorgung für Ihre Augen zu bieten – Ihre Augen sind unser
Fokus. Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum der Augenheilkunde wie allgemeine Kontrollen,
erweiterte [Vorsorge][59] bis hin zur [Premium-Kataraktchirurgie][60] und Untersuchungen des [Grünen
Stars (Glaukom)][61] – gemeinsam finden wir die für Sie beste Behandlungsstruktur.

Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf eine regionale sowie persönliche Betreuung und arbeiten mit einem
professionellen Team daran, Sie zu allen Anliegen zu Ihrer Augengesundheit bestmöglich zu beraten.

## Augenerkankungen gezielt erkennen und vorbeugen

In vielen medizinischen Bereichen begegnen uns immer wieder Vorsorgetermine, jedoch werden die Augen
dabei häufig außer Acht gelassen. Damit bestimmte Erkrankungen Ihres Auges bestmöglich behandelt
werden können, ist eine frühzeitige Erkennung dieser von besonderer Bedeutung. Buchen Sie daher
jetzt Ihren Vorsorgetermin.

[Warum vorsorgen?][62]

Als qualifizierte Augenärzte in Ihrer Region stehen wir Ihnen in allen Lebenslagen zur Seite und
finden die für Sie beste Behandlung. Von Erkrankungen des Grünen oder Grauen Stars ([Glaukom][63]
und [Katarakt][64]) bis zu Veränderungen an Ihrer [Netzhaut][65] oder anderen Leidenserscheinungen,
mit unseren Spezialisten beraten wir Sie zu unseren Behandlungsmethoden, um Ihre Sehkraft zu
erhalten.

# Klare Sicht, frische Augen – Trockene Augen gezielt behandeln

Trockene Augen, auch als Sicca-Syndrom bekannt, entstehen durch eine unzureichende Benetzung der
Augenoberfläche mit Tränenflüssigkeit. Ursachen können Umwelteinflüsse wie Klimaanlagen und
Bildschirmarbeit, bestimmte Medikamente oder gesundheitliche Probleme wie Diabetes sein. Symptome
umfassen Brennen, Jucken, Rötungen und ein Fremdkörpergefühl. Die Behandlung reicht von künstlichen
Tränen bis hin zu entzündungshemmenden Tropfen. Vorbeugend helfen regelmäßige Pausen bei der
Bildschirmarbeit, ausreichendes Trinken und das Vermeiden von Zugluft und Rauch.

Wenn Sie von Trockenen Augen betroffen sind, dann wenden Sie sich gern an unser [DryEye Center][83].

Carolyn

…By integrating her holistic approach into my care, **I am now essentially free from daily anxiety

my devotions again. I now have the desire to exercise and make better health choices, and I am
laughing again and smiling.** I highly recommend Focus because they desire to truly help and not
just rush and prescribe pills. They really made me feel they cared. **[Read more…][9]**

… Dr. Louis identified a long term condition that **enabled me to get off an RX that I had been on
for years! **I was VERY hesitant; I probably spoke to Jeff (the office manager) at least 3 different

ever spent. Save yourself the research, skepticism, etc – and just get in there! **[Read

## It’s not all in your head


For too long you’ve been told that if you could just take more medications… or take them more
consistently, or take different ones, or try therapy again… or try a different kind of therapy, it
would would all eventually snap into place and your life would make sense again. But it hasn’t
worked out that way.


You’ve tried different practitioners and therapists or you weren’t even able to find one that
understands and applies what I’m about to tell you. You see, if you’re going to build a puzzle it’s
important to make sure you have all the right pieces in place before you start. Otherwise, your
experience is going to be very frustrating and full of disappointment. For too long you’ve been
building without some *really* important pieces.


Did you know that there are over 20 different physical conditions that can show up as mental health
symptoms? You might have severe panic attacks, generalized anxiety, depression, severe mood swings,
or even auditory hallucinations caused by disorders in your body. That’s right. It’s important to
make sure your body is functioning like it should, before you start tackling mental health symptoms.


While I do provide therapy and medication management, I don’t believe it should be the goal for
everybody and for all time. I specialize in applying all missing pieces into your care. Whether it’s
your childhood experiences changing how your body responds to stress… or experiences that you’ve had
as an adult keeping you in survival mode… or how your hormones are affecting your mood… or how your
genetics are reducing the effectiveness of your medications… I go through it all. I can
also address the side effects of your medication, so you can have happier and more fulfilling
relationships. And (when the time is right) we can work towards getting you down to the lowest
medication dose possible (tapering/de-prescribing).


As your doctor, my priority is to uncover and address the hidden causes of your condition. I will
help you understand what’s taking place in your body by looking at the physical & mental conditions
that could be hindering your mental wellness. Together, we’ll make an action plan that will use all
the pieces that are important to your peace and stability using the latest specialty tests, holistic
methods, and most effective therapies for long-term healing. I aim to use the most convenient, and
most effective holistic & integrative therapies to help you feel well, happy, and hopeful again.
Let’s get started today!

## Harvey Young Advanced Holistic Therapy
## Central London Chiropractor & Integrative Health Clinic

Welcome to [Harvey Young Advanced Holistic Therapy][45], an established chiropractic and integrative
health clinic in Central London. Led by Dr Harvey Young (Doctor of Chiropractic), our team provides
gentle, evidence-informed chiropractic care alongside complementary therapies such as
Photobiomodulation (PBM) light therapy, movement-based rehabilitation, yoga, and mindfulness-based
coaching.

Our chiropractors are registered with the General Chiropractic Council (GCC) and work to regulated
professional standards. We focus on low-force chiropractic techniques, avoiding high-force manual
methods. Care is centred on restoring spinal and joint function, easing tension, and improving how
the body moves and feels. Each plan is shaped around your assessment, goals, and preferences, with a
focus on recovery, posture, and longer-term resilience.

We serve patients across Soho, Marylebone, Mayfair, Liverpool Street, and soon Canary Wharf, making
chiropractic and holistic care accessible throughout Central London.

Our integrative approach helps people recover from injuries and manage ongoing musculoskeletal
concerns by addressing movement habits and postural patterns, while improving joint function and the
way related nerves and soft tissues respond. The aim is simple, better movement, better function,
and a body that feels easier to live in.

babies to older adults, helping each person move towards a more balanced and fulfilling life.

support long-term wellbeing, posture, and resilience.

## Harvey Young Advanced Holistic Therapy
## Central London Chiropractor & Integrative Health Clinic

Welcome to [Harvey Young Advanced Holistic Therapy][45], an established chiropractic and integrative
health clinic in Central London. Led by Dr Harvey Young (Doctor of Chiropractic), our team provides
gentle, evidence-informed chiropractic care alongside complementary therapies such as
Photobiomodulation (PBM) light therapy, movement-based rehabilitation, yoga, and mindfulness-based
coaching.

Our chiropractors are registered with the General Chiropractic Council (GCC) and work to regulated
professional standards. We focus on low-force chiropractic techniques, avoiding high-force manual
methods. Care is centred on restoring spinal and joint function, easing tension, and improving how
the body moves and feels. Each plan is shaped around your assessment, goals, and preferences, with a
focus on recovery, posture, and longer-term resilience.

We serve patients across Soho, Marylebone, Mayfair, Liverpool Street, and soon Canary Wharf, making
chiropractic and holistic care accessible throughout Central London.

We focus on meaningful improvement over time, not just short-term changes.

Our integrative approach helps people recover from injuries and manage ongoing musculoskeletal
concerns by addressing movement habits and postural patterns, while improving joint function and the
way related nerves and soft tissues respond. The aim is simple, better movement, better function,
and a body that feels easier to live in.

## Discover *Whole-Person* Health

Good health is more than the absence of pain.

At our Central London clinics, we use an evidence-informed, whole-person approach, addressing spinal
health, movement patterns, posture, and stress-related factors.

Led by Dr Harvey Young (Doctor of Chiropractic) - with over 25 years' combined experience in
chiropractic, yoga, movement, and integrative therapies - we care for people of all ages, from
babies to older adults, helping each person move towards a more balanced and fulfilling life.

## Why Choose Our Chiropractic and Integrative Care at Harvey Young Advanced Holistic Therapy?

We go beyond the misconception that chiropractic is simply about "cracking joints" or offering
short-term fixes.

Our gentle, evidence-informed chiropractic techniques focus on spinal alignment and nervous system
function, helping the body move and heal more efficiently.

Alongside chiropractic care, our integrative therapies — including Photobiomodulation (PBM) light
therapy, corrective yoga, insight mindfulness and movement-based rehabilitation — work together to
support long-term wellbeing, posture, and resilience.

Our approach is guided by the Five Elements of Health: Alignment, Movement, Mindset, Nutrition, and
Rest — creating a strong foundation for lasting health and vitality.

[OUR SERVICES][48]

## Chiropractic Care - Regulated, Evidence-Informed Healthcare

Chiropractic is a statutorily regulated healthcare profession in the UK, overseen by the General
Chiropractic Council (GCC) under the Chiropractors Act 1994. Chiropractors are primary-contact
practitioners with expertise in assessing, diagnosing, and managing musculoskeletal (MSK)
conditions, so you can access safe, evidence-informed care directly, without a referral.

Our approach is patient-centred and holistic. Each care plan is tailored to you, combining gentle
hands-on care with movement guidance, posture and ergonomic advice, and practical lifestyle
strategies. We often collaborate with GPs, physiotherapists, surgeons, and other health
professionals to support your recovery and long-term wellbeing. By combining clinical expertise with
practical, we help you restore function, prevent recurrence, and build a resilient foundation for
lifelong musculoskeletal health.

## London’s leading therapeutic Low Level Laser Clinic.

We are experts in the application of Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT). which uses non-thermal laser,
known medically as Photobiomodulation Therapy (PBMT) and more commonly as Red Light Therapy (RLT).
We combine the use of LLLT (light wavelengths in the Infrared / IR and Near Infrared / NIR range),
to provide safe, organic, efficient healing.

[Our background][65] is unique. We are pioneers in [Red Light Therapy for Fertility][66], offering
therapy for ovarian rejuvenation and reproductive health, including endometriosis and PCOS. The
[Ovarian Rejuvenation Programme][67] is developed in collaboration with expert fertility
gynaecologists, where we combine Red Light with Ovarian PRP for women of all ages. We also lead UK
and European research in [Therapeutic Laser for Hypothyroid][68], extending proven protocols from
Turkey and Brazil, to develop our own published [lower fluency protocols][69].

Our natural health service employs outstanding medical therapeutic lasers to aid the recovery of a
wide spectrum of health conditions, including [Smoking Cessation][70]. We provide PBM Therapy for
[Oral Mucositis][71], approved by [NICE, UK][72] in 2018. Similarly we lead in the development of
Low Level Laser Therapy for inflammatory brain conditions including [Autism Spectrum Disorder
][73](ASD) and [Neurodegenerative Disease][74]. We are a [Certified Melillo Method Practitioner][75]
Centre for Functional Development Behavioural Neuroimmunology, accredited by the Interdisciplinary
Association of Functional Neurosciences and Rehabilitation ([IAFNR][76]).

Read our clinical case study series paper, published in PubMed:
[The Efficacy of Multiwavelength Red and Near-Infrared Transdermal Photobiomodulation Light Therapy
in Enhancing Female Fertility Outcomes and Improving Reproductive Health: A Prospective Case Series
with 9-Month Follow-Up][77] (Phypers et al 2024).

### About Chattanooga

Chattanooga is the world’s largest manufacturer of rehabilitation equipment for treating
musculoskeletal, neurological and soft tissue disorders. For over seven decades, Chattanooga has set
a benchmark for leadership, reliability and excellence. Our products contribute to better treatment
outcomes in hospitals, clinics and home settings worldwide.

Chattanooga is a brand of Enovis. Enovis® is a world leading orthopaedic company focused on helping
people maintain and regain the joy of natural mobility. Offering a diverse portfolio of products and
solutions to prevent injury, rehabilitate muscles, bones and joints and treat pain, we strive to
help people live their lives to the fullest.

We believe that our powerful brands, comprehensive range of products, extensive distribution
network, unwavering focus on quality, innovation and customer service, and our strong relationships
with orthopaedic and physical therapy professionals have all contributed to our leading market
position. We have award winning manufacturing facilities across the globe with industry leading
product design teams to continue the development and production of new products.

### About Chattanooga

Chattanooga is the world’s largest manufacturer of rehabilitation equipment for treating
musculoskeletal, neurological and soft tissue disorders. For over seven decades, Chattanooga has set
a benchmark for leadership, reliability and excellence. Our products contribute to better treatment
outcomes in hospitals, clinics and home settings worldwide.

Chattanooga is a brand of Enovis. Enovis® is a world leading orthopaedic company focused on helping
people maintain and regain the joy of natural mobility. Offering a diverse portfolio of products and
solutions to prevent injury, rehabilitate muscles, bones and joints and treat pain, we strive to
help people live their lives to the fullest.

We believe that our powerful brands, comprehensive range of products, extensive distribution
network, unwavering focus on quality, innovation and customer service, and our strong relationships
with orthopaedic and physical therapy professionals have all contributed to our leading market
position. We have award winning manufacturing facilities across the globe with industry leading
product design teams to continue the development and production of new products.

### What is Light Therapy?

Hailed by doctors, researchers, athletes, and beauty specialists around the world, Low Level Light
Therapy is a stunning scientific breakthrough that harnesses the natural therapeutic power of light
by using the latest advances in LED technology.

### How It Works

Light therapy effects tissue at a cellular level using low-level LED light to penetrate the skin’s
surface and into underlying tissues, stimulating the body’s natural cellular functions. This
application of specific non-ionizing wavelengths of light lead to non-invasive, drug-free medical
and wellness benefits.

### Choose LightMD

At LightMD, our patented technology is able to work deep into the body to provide relief from many
of today’s bodily concerns. Combined with the knowledge of our own medical experts, we offer a safe
but effective solution that many others can’t compete with. Plus, we’re FDA approved! #K142256

Our Ethos

## We believe in **more life** — more energy, more healing, more time doing what matters. MedWave
## exists to give practitioners the tools to deliver measurable, life-changing outcomes.

**Photobiomodulation** (PBM) — commonly known as **red light therapy** — uses specific wavelengths
of light to stimulate cellular energy production at the mitochondrial level. It’s not new. The
science dates back over 50 years, with peer-reviewed studies confirming its safety and efficacy
across a wide range of medical and aesthetic applications.

Our Technology

## Real Science. *Real* Results.

Clinical-grade photobiomodulation — precision-engineered for measurable outcomes across every
application.

### Experience the Future of *Non-Invasive Care.*

Imagine a world where the first treatment isn’t a pill — it’s energy.

Where clinics restore how your cells function before reaching for medication. Where spas deliver
real health outcomes alongside beauty. Where wounds heal faster because we gave the body what it
needed to repair itself.

This is the future MedWave is building.

One device at a time. One practitioner at a time. One patient at a time.

Accelerated Tissue Repair Reduced Inflammation Body Contouring & Fat Loss Chronic Pain Relief
Collagen Stimulation Neurological Support Improved Circulation Wound Healing

MedWave puts proven photobiomodulation science to work in your practice — with clinical-grade
devices designed and built in South Africa, engineered with premium European components, and
supported by local service and parts.

The HyperVibe whole body vibration plate is the perfect complement to MedWave photobiomodulation.

## La photobiomodulation
## (PBM)

La PBM agit principalement au niveau des mitochondries des cellules, favorisant la production d’ATP,
une molécule énergétique essentielle, et activant divers mécanismes de réparation cellulaire et de
croissance tissulaire.

situations professionnelles pour soutenir ces processus, adaptant ses fonctions pour répondre à des

## La photobiomodulation
## (PBM)

La PBM agit principalement au niveau des mitochondries des cellules, favorisant la production d’ATP,
une molécule énergétique essentielle, et activant divers mécanismes de réparation cellulaire et de
croissance tissulaire.

#### Photon Penetration

Near-infrared wavelength — specifically selected for optimal tissue penetration — passes through
scalp and skull to reach targeted cortical regions without heating tissue.

2

#### Mitochondrial Activation

Photons are absorbed by cytochrome c oxidase (CCO) in neuronal mitochondria, triggering enhanced ATP
production, reduced oxidative stress, and restored cellular energy metabolism.

3

#### Cerebral Blood Flow Modulation

Dose-dependent changes in regional cerebral blood flow are confirmed by BOLD fMRI. Effects extend
globally — beyond directly irradiated regions — via neural network connectivity.

4

#### Metabolic Enhancement & Neuroplasticity

FDG-PET imaging confirms increased glucose uptake in prefrontal cortex. Enhanced synaptic function
and neuronal connectivity in mood-regulating circuits support lasting clinical benefit.

Ongoing pain, recurring injuries, or uncertainty about your next step can feel frustrating and

complex, long-standing conditions.

Studies describe how groups respond. Your biology runs its own experiment every day. Outliyr reads

The problem

## The research is right on average. You’re bio-individual.

Health studies describe the average response of a group. Your genes, gut, environment, and history
make your response different. That gap is where years of guessing live.

01

### Generic advice has a hidden failure rate

A protocol with great evidence behind it can still do nothing for you. The studies were never about
you specifically.

02

### Guessing costs more than money

The bigger price is time, energy, and attention. Months on something inert is a season of your life
you can’t refund.

03

### Your best interventions stay hidden

The thing that would work shockingly well for you might be unpopular, under-researched, or sitting
unused in your cabinet right now.

How it works

## Stop collecting protocols. Start collecting answers.

Outliyr turns the health optimization work you’re already doing into clear keep-it-or-drop-it
verdicts, graded by how strong the evidence is for you specifically.

Every supplement, device, and protocol you’re running, in one place. Spot the overlaps, the gaps,

## ADVOCACY

Named the 2026 Global Health Innovation Advocate of the Year, the Foundation collaborates with
scientists, practitioners, and government officials to expand acceptance and application of PBM.
This includes facilitating collaborative research, publicizing clinical evidence, and promoting
policy and programmatic changes. Foundation board members and advisors have presented to the White
House, Executive Branch Agencies, Congress, Medical and Policy Forums, and the United Nations.

**[Learn more»][65]**

[PBM Basics - knee pain]

## PBM BASICS

Learn about the science and application of Photobiomodulation (PBM), successfully treating COVID-19,
Opioid Use Disorder (OUD), and traumatic brain injury (TBI); managing pain; healing wounds;
preventing Cancer therapy’s side-effects; and helping our Military. Over 100 million patients have
received PBM in clinical settings proving PBM effective and safe.

[**Learn More»**][66]

[PBM Research]

## RESEARCH

The Foundation funds and coordinates PBM research around the world.  We share our research with
healthcare leaders and senior policy officials. Evidence of PBM’s successful treatments supports
expanding insurance coverage, treatment protocols, and order sets so patients receive the full
benefit of PBM therapy.

[**Learn More»**][67]

[PBM Education - auditorium]

## EDUCATION

The Foundation supports establishing degree and certification programs for using PBM to treat
patients. We work with medical and nursing schools to support curriculum development, learning
module design, and faculty recruitment. There are now formal medical and nursing degrees for PBM
with more to come!

## Light Therapy

## A proven healing technology  for a healthy life

Photobiomodulation also known as red light therapy or low level laser therapy studies the biological
reactions to specific light wavelengths exposure. Light absorption triggers reactions at the cell
level by boosting mitochondria activity. Years of studies have shown that effects include:
* pain relief
* improved blood flow
* soft and hard tissue regeneration
* metabolism regulation

Applications are proven in fields as diverse as dentistry, oncology, diabetes, mental health and
general wellness.

As a completely natural way of healing, photobiomodulation can be used as a complement with
traditional treatments or as a substitute.

## Our devices

## Universal high quality devices

With strong scientific and engineering expertise, PBM’s vision is to bring photobiomodulation out of
the labs or professional practices and make it available to all including animals.

Our devices are powered by the world-leading scientists and doctors of light therapy in the industry

## Light Therapy

## A proven healing technology  for a healthy life

Photobiomodulation also known as red light therapy or low level laser therapy studies the biological
reactions to specific light wavelengths exposure. Light absorption triggers reactions at the cell
level by boosting mitochondria activity. Years of studies have shown that effects include:
* pain relief
* improved blood flow
* soft and hard tissue regeneration
* metabolism regulation

Applications are proven in fields as diverse as dentistry, oncology, diabetes, mental health and
general wellness.

As a completely natural way of healing, photobiomodulation can be used as a complement with
traditional treatments or as a substitute.

## Experience The Difference

Our patients have inspiring stories to tell about turning despair into hope, frustration into
empowerment, can't into can and disability into ability.

### living your life to the fullest.

Through targeted therapies such as vestibular rehabilitation, eye movement exercises, cognitive
training, and receptor-based brain stimulation, we promote neuroplasticity, improve brain
connectivity, and alleviate symptoms associated with Post-Concussion Syndrome, dizziness, migraines,
balance, and many other neurological challenges.

[Plasticity-brain-centers-logo]

The brain is the engine that runs the body, continuously sending signals that allow us to function.
As a society, we tend to prioritize other areas of our health but neglect our brain health. So, when
faced with an issue, the big question is, where do you go and what do you do? Plasticity Brain
Centers is a cutting-edge, rehabilitation clinic led by experienced, dedicated, patient-focused
doctors. Our doctors provide non-pharmaceutical and non-invasive brain training founded on the
concept that the brain is capable of learning and changing, with nearly limitless potential,
throughout life. This concept has been termed “neuroplasticity”. Plasticity Brain Centers can
improve the neurological performance and quality of life of patients with brain injuries and
neurological disorders.

treatments, exosomes, stem cells, and peptides.

### About Retina Consultants of Muncie

At Retina Consultants of Muncie, vitreoretinal ophthalmologist Jeffrey Rapkin, MD, provides
comprehensive eye care to people 12 and older in Muncie, Indiana, and throughout Delaware County. 

Dr. Rapkin began his professional education at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, earning his
Bachelor of Science in premedical science. After graduation, he enrolled at the Medical College of
Wisconsin in Milwaukee, obtaining his Doctor of Medicine.

Before entering private practice, Dr. Rapkin completed an internship and an ophthalmology residency
at Henry Ford Hospital in Detroit, Michigan, and a retina and vitreous surgery fellowship at the
Southern Illinois University School of Medicine in Springfield.

Dr. Rapkin has served the Muncie and Richmond communities since 1996. At Retina Consultants of
Muncie, he offers full-service treatment for diabetic retinopathy and other age-related eye
diseases.

People from all over East Central Indiana visit Dr. Rapkin for treatment of various eye conditions,
including [macular degeneration][30], [retinal detachment][31], and [floaters][32]. Dr. Rapkin also
provides more specialized care, including the treatment of [retinal vascular diseases][33] caused by
high blood pressure and circulatory issues. 

Dr. Rapkin prides himself on providing convenient and high-quality care. To ensure patient
convenience, he offers in-home monitoring of eye disease and surgical procedures at facilities in
Muncie and Anderson.

Retina Consultants of Muncie is conveniently located and accepts most health insurance, including
Veterans Administration (VA) insurance. Many patients come from out of town to receive comprehensive
evaluation and imaging services for various eye conditions. 

Dr. Rapkin is a member and the past president of Muncie Sunrise Rotary and has served on the board
of directors of the Muncie Symphony Orchestra and the Muncie Civic Theatre. He welcomes anyone
seeking high-quality eye care to Retina Consultants of Muncie today.

To learn more, call the Retina Consultants of Muncie office or request an appointment online.

## Early Detection Saves Lives

At Sascan we utilize a multispectral imaging technology platform for multimodal screening and early
detection of potentially malignant lesions.

[ Discover OralScan ][54]

### Technology

Detects early biochemical and morphological tissue changes using multispectral imaging.

### Edge

Real-time monochrome imaging accurately maps hemoglobin absorption to biopsy sites

### Application

Our multimodal technology detects most cell carcinomas and adapts to endoscopy

### Impact

Our technology enables a low-cost screening of oral and cervical tissues saving lives.

## About Us

## Transforming Science Into Real World Healthcare Impact.

OralScan bridges the gap between complex biophotonics research and point-of-care patient impact by
fundamentally redefining how oral cancer is detected. OralScan is an multimodal imaging device for
the early detection of oral cancers and biopsy guidance. Backed by a proprietary ML algorithm, it
assists clinicians in identifying suspicious lesions with greater accuracy in real-time, supporting
timely diagnosis, biopsy guidance and improved patient care outcomes. By substituting invasive
anxiety with a quick, pain-free, and affordable scan, Sascan Meditech has successfully democratized
high-tech oncology diagnostics, bringing life-saving early detection out of elite hospitals and
directly into the communities where it is needed most.

## Our Impact

## Driving Innovation in Advanced Healthcare Solutions

Empowering healthcare with ML-driven innovation, advanced medical technology, and reliable screening
solutions to support clinicians, hospitals, and early disease detection for better patient outcomes.

## Early Detection Saves Lives

At Sascan we utilize a multispectral imaging technology platform for multimodal screening and early
detection of potentially malignant lesions.

[ Discover OralScan ][54]

### Technology

Detects early biochemical and morphological tissue changes using multispectral imaging.

### Edge

Real-time monochrome imaging accurately maps hemoglobin absorption to biopsy sites

### Application

Our multimodal technology detects most cell carcinomas and adapts to endoscopy

### Impact

Our technology enables a low-cost screening of oral and cervical tissues saving lives.

## About Us

## Transforming Science Into Real World Healthcare Impact.

OralScan bridges the gap between complex biophotonics research and point-of-care patient impact by
fundamentally redefining how oral cancer is detected. OralScan is an multimodal imaging device for
the early detection of oral cancers and biopsy guidance. Backed by a proprietary ML algorithm, it
assists clinicians in identifying suspicious lesions with greater accuracy in real-time, supporting
timely diagnosis, biopsy guidance and improved patient care outcomes. By substituting invasive
anxiety with a quick, pain-free, and affordable scan, Sascan Meditech has successfully democratized
high-tech oncology diagnostics, bringing life-saving early detection out of elite hospitals and
directly into the communities where it is needed most.

  ### About
  
  ][132]
  
  Soterix Medical Inc. (SMI) was formed to develop and deploy innovative medical treatments focused
  on neuropsychiatric and neurological disorders and rehabilitation. Founded in 2008, SMI is the
  world leader in clinical trials for non-invasive neuromodulation working with over 1,200 medical
  centers in the US and worldwide. SMI has licensed and developed a comprehensive intellectual
  property portfolio that includes High-Definition transcranial Direct Current Stimulation
  (HD-tDCS), Limited Total Energy tDCS (LTE-tDCS), Neurotargeting, and improving precision of
  Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation. From the most targeted non-invasive clinical systems to the
  most portable units, Soterix Medical provides clinicians and patients with unique and adaptable
  solutions. While ongoing trials use investigational devices that are regulated/limited by US or
  Federal law, SMI has secured multiple clinical approvals worldwide (EU-CE; Canada-Health Canada;
  Brazil-Anvisa; Australia-TGA, etc.). SMI is also diversified to distribute synergistic
  technologies and provides services in image analysis, modeling,consumer product human factors, as
  well as defense and space applications. SMI currently holds multiple US clinical clearances on
  synergistic technologies. SMI is proudly based in the Tri-state area with international
  distributors in all major markets.

## About The Biofeedback, Education,
## & Training Center

Struggling with anxiety, poor sleep, brain fog, or feeling stuck—even when you’ve tried multiple
approaches without lasting results?


At The Biofeedback, Education & Training Center (B.E.T. Center), we take a comprehensive,
neurocognitive approach to mental health and brain wellness. Rather than focusing solely on symptom
management, we work to understand how your brain and nervous system are functioning, and how to
improve that functioning in a meaningful, lasting way.


Our services are provided by licensed clinicians and board-certified practitioners, ensuring a high
standard of care that integrates clinical expertise with advanced brain-based technologies.

 

Our process begins with a thorough, integrative evaluation that may include counseling, quantitative
EEG (QEEG) brain mapping, and both objective and subjective assessments. This allows us to identify
patterns in brain and nervous system functioning that may be contributing to symptoms such as
anxiety, ADHD, depression, insomnia, cognitive fatigue, or emotional dysregulation.

 

Based on these findings, we develop a personalized, multi-modality treatment plan that may include
neurofeedback, biofeedback, and evidence-based counseling approaches such as CBT, CBT-I, and
brainspotting. Treatment is continuously guided by clinical data, client-reported outcomes, and
observed progress, supporting a more precise and adaptive approach to care.

 

Clients who engage in this process commonly experience improvements in sleep quality, attention and
cognitive clarity, emotional regulation, and overall resilience to stress. Outcomes vary by
individual; however, our goal is to support measurable, functional improvements in daily life and
long-term brain health.

 

We proudly serve individuals and families throughout Plano, Dallas, Frisco, McKinney, Richardson,
Allen, and surrounding North Dallas Metroplex, offering both in-office and remote training options
to increase accessibility and consistency of care.

 

If you are looking for a clinically grounded, brain-based approach to improving mental wellness and
cognitive functioning, our team is here to help.


We welcome the opportunity to discuss a personalized plan aligned with your needs and goals.

## About Vivolight

“Pioneering Advanced Healthcare Solutions”
Vivolight Medical specializes in medical laser technology, we are dedicated to the independent
development, global innovation, and in-house manufacturing of minimally invasive interventional
diagnostic and therapeutic medical devices utilizing laser technology. By integrating cutting-edge
photoelectric technology with medical and engineering expertise, we have achieved comprehensive
mastery of core underlying technologies in laser diagnostics and therapeutics, fiber-optic
catheters, and image processing. This has enabled us to develop a robust "diagnosis and treatment
integrated" platform that spans multiple disease categories.
* We were the first chinese OCT manufacturer to expand into international markets.
* We are also the first China-developed OCT manufacturer to obtain FDA clearance!

## What Does A Naturopath Do?

Naturopathic Medicine is a primary health care profession which includes a variety of naturally
based therapies. Naturopathic treatments are aimed at removing the cause of disease and support the
innate healing processes within the body. The focus of naturopathic care is centered on the
individual, their health (physical, emotional social and spiritual), family history, and lifestyle.

Our naturopathic doctors provide a data-based approach, offering lab testing and lab follow-up to
diagnose underlying problems and track the effectiveness of treatments over time.

Treatments we provide to our patients are natural, science-based and support the overall health and
strength of the patient. At the end of each visit, we prepare written treatment plans individually
for each patient’s needs. These may include nutritional supplements, herbal medicines, bio-identical
hormones and diet/lifestyle changes. There is no “one-size-fits-all” approach in naturopathic
medicine!

### What Happens At Your First Visit To A Naturopath?
1. Your naturopathic doctor will complete a detailed intake of your case which can take up to 90
   minutes. This approach allows your naturopath to learn a great deal about your health right from
   the first visit!
2. A thorough review is completed of health systems covering areas such as hormones, digestion,
   sleep, diet, stress, family history and more. As naturopathic doctors we always look for the
   underlying causes of disease and support health in a holistic way.
3. Your naturopath will help clarify your specific health goals during this session, so you can work
   on what’s most important to you.
4. After each visit, your naturopathic doctor will create an individual written treatment plan for
   you including natural treatment options, and lab testing suggestions to clarify causes or provide
   a diagnosis.

#### Follow-up visits

Follow-up naturopathic visits are booked as needed, and are typically 45, or 30 minutes in length.
In general, most patients require several consultations at the start of naturopathic care and then
move to a maintenance or followup schedule with visits scheduled less often.

connectivité cérébrale et de la fonction mitochondriale.

### Qu'est-ce qu'une section FAQ?

Une section FAQ peut être utilisée pour répondre rapidement aux questions fréquemment posées sur

### Pourquoi les FAQ sont-elles importantes?

Les FAQ sont un excellent moyen d'aider les visiteurs à trouver rapidement des réponses aux
questions courantes sur votre entreprise et de créer une meilleure expérience de navigation sur
votre site.

### Où puis-je ajouter mes FAQ?

Les FAQ peuvent être ajoutées à n'importe quelle page de votre site ou sur votre appli mobile Wix.

### Comment puis-je ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse?

Pour ajouter une nouvelle question/réponse, suivez ces étapes:

1. Depuis le tableau de bord ou l'Éditeur, cliquez sur le bouton «Gérer la FAQ».

2. Cliquez sur «Ajouter», puis sélectionnez «Question/Réponse».

3. Choisissez une catégorie pour votre question/réponse.

4. Enregistrez et publiez.


Vous pouvez modifier votre FAQ à tout moment.

### Puis-je ajouter une image, une vidéo ou un GIF à ma FAQ?

Oui. Pour ajouter un média, suivez ces étapes:

## About Us

At our Naples, FL-based Brain Rejuvenation Clinic, we specialize in cutting-edge, science-backed
therapies designed to restore and optimize brain health. We incorporate the WAVi Scan System which
allows clinicians to identify early signs of cognitive impairment and tailor treatment protocols to
optimize patient outcomes. Utilizing BAHI Therapy, Hydrogen Inhalation, Photo Biomodulation, and
Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, we activate the body's natural healing processes to enhance cognitive
function and neurological recovery. Our expert team is dedicated to providing personalized,
non-invasive testing and treatments that support brain restoration, mental clarity, and overall
well-being. Experience the future of brain health with innovative therapies that rejuvenate your
mind from the inside out.

mental well-being.

# Dalton Brothers

##### O.D. Doctor of Optometry

Brothers Vision Consulting delivers exceptional consultation services backed by a board-certified
optometrist. Our clinician-led sessions are designed to enhance your skills and expertise when
integrating emerging technology into your clinics. Together, we will explore the research that paved
the way for these novel therapies and help improve the communications that leads to better patient
outcomes.

## Areas of Expertise

##### Ocular Aesthetics, Advanced Dry Eye, Regenerative Medicine & Vision Industry Consultation.

[IMG_8555.JPG]

Welcome to Brothers Vision Consulting, where exceptional eye care meets innovative solutions. Led by
Dalton Brothers, O.D., a proud third-generation optometrist, our consultancy is dedicated to
advancing the field of eye care. Dalton graduated from the University of Missouri Saint Louis
College of Optometry in 2019 and has since joined his family's esteemed practice in Joplin,
Missouri. He specializes in ocular aesthetics and dry eye, providing cutting-edge therapies such as
Plate Rich Plasma, Intense Pulsed Light, and Photobiomodulation.

 

In 2021, Dalton expanded his passion for eye care by offering consulting services to fellow
optometrists and ophthalmologists, helping them integrate these advanced therapies into their own
clinics. Our mission is to empower eye care professionals with knowledge and innovative techniques
aimed at enhancing patient outcomes.


Outside of the clinic, Dalton cherishes time spent with his wife and three daughters, bringing a
family-oriented approach to his practice. At Brothers Vision Consulting, we strive to provide the
highest level of care and expertise in every interaction.

Areas of Expertise

## Consultation Services

1

### Advanced InfinityPro LLLT Applications

During these sessions, we will focus on how to implement low level light therapy (LLLT) technology
into your clinic, how to communicate this therapy with staff and patients, and establish a line of
communication for ongoing clinical support for 12 months. Anything I've designed to make my life
easier in clinic will be made available to you as well, including patient handouts, log sheets,
consent forms and much more! 

[More Info ][6]

2

### Advanced Dry Eye Therapies: (IPL + LLLT)

During this training session, we aim to empower providers to confidently implement Intense Pulsed
Light (IPL) and Low Level Light Therapy (LLLT) to enhance both their dry eye and aesthetic outcomes
within their clinics. Our comprehensive training covers crucial aspects, including patient
selection, treatment vs. maintenance care, and effective communication strategies. Additionally, 6
months of ongoing clinical support is also included with this purchase. 

[More Info ][7]

3

### Industry Partner Consultation

Brothers Vision Consulting offers assistance in the publishing of  independent clinical findings,
including research study assessments and protocol design. We offer sponsorships through public
health webinars and podcasts involving, dry eye, aesthetics, and various other applications
regarding the use of diagnostic and therapeutic devices. Through these partnerships, we offer
ongoing strategic guidance for companies within the vision industry.  

[More Info ][8]

# Herzlich willkommen bei den Augenpartnern – Ihre Augengesundheit in guten Händen

Als überörtliche Augenarztpraxis zwischen Hamburg, Bremen und Hannover haben wir es uns zum Ziel
gesetzt, Ihnen die beste medizinische Versorgung für Ihre Augen zu bieten – Ihre Augen sind unser
Fokus. Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum der Augenheilkunde wie allgemeine Kontrollen,
erweiterte [Vorsorge][59] bis hin zur [Premium-Kataraktchirurgie][60] und Untersuchungen des [Grünen
Stars (Glaukom)][61] – gemeinsam finden wir die für Sie beste Behandlungsstruktur.

Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf eine regionale sowie persönliche Betreuung und arbeiten mit einem
professionellen Team daran, Sie zu allen Anliegen zu Ihrer Augengesundheit bestmöglich zu beraten.

[Ihre Augengesundheit in guten Händen]
[Augenuntersuchung: Vorsorge]

## Augenerkankungen gezielt erkennen und vorbeugen

In vielen medizinischen Bereichen begegnen uns immer wieder Vorsorgetermine, jedoch werden die Augen
dabei häufig außer Acht gelassen. Damit bestimmte Erkrankungen Ihres Auges bestmöglich behandelt
werden können, ist eine frühzeitige Erkennung dieser von besonderer Bedeutung. Buchen Sie daher
jetzt Ihren Vorsorgetermin.

[Warum vorsorgen?][62]

## Die passenden Behandlungen für Ihre Augengesundheit

Als qualifizierte Augenärzte in Ihrer Region stehen wir Ihnen in allen Lebenslagen zur Seite und
finden die für Sie beste Behandlung. Von Erkrankungen des Grünen oder Grauen Stars ([Glaukom][63]
und [Katarakt][64]) bis zu Veränderungen an Ihrer [Netzhaut][65] oder anderen Leidenserscheinungen,
mit unseren Spezialisten beraten wir Sie zu unseren Behandlungsmethoden, um Ihre Sehkraft zu
erhalten.

# Klare Sicht, frische Augen – Trockene Augen gezielt behandeln

Trockene Augen, auch als Sicca-Syndrom bekannt, entstehen durch eine unzureichende Benetzung der
Augenoberfläche mit Tränenflüssigkeit. Ursachen können Umwelteinflüsse wie Klimaanlagen und
Bildschirmarbeit, bestimmte Medikamente oder gesundheitliche Probleme wie Diabetes sein. Symptome
umfassen Brennen, Jucken, Rötungen und ein Fremdkörpergefühl. Die Behandlung reicht von künstlichen
Tränen bis hin zu entzündungshemmenden Tropfen. Vorbeugend helfen regelmäßige Pausen bei der
Bildschirmarbeit, ausreichendes Trinken und das Vermeiden von Zugluft und Rauch.

Wenn Sie von Trockenen Augen betroffen sind, dann wenden Sie sich gern an unser [DryEye Center][83].

function, or the ability to heal. At Elevation Health Center, we focus on restoring health at the
cellular level – addressing the root cause, not just the symptoms.

in our society that it seems normal, but the reverse is actually true. Sickness, pain, and disease

properly. When that happens, the innate intelligence of the body takes over and gets you back to the
pain-free, optimally-functioning state you are meant to be in.

## It’s not all in your head


For too long you’ve been told that if you could just take more medications… or take them more
consistently, or take different ones, or try therapy again… or try a different kind of therapy, it
would would all eventually snap into place and your life would make sense again. But it hasn’t
worked out that way.


You’ve tried different practitioners and therapists or you weren’t even able to find one that
understands and applies what I’m about to tell you. You see, if you’re going to build a puzzle it’s
important to make sure you have all the right pieces in place before you start. Otherwise, your
experience is going to be very frustrating and full of disappointment. For too long you’ve been
building without some *really* important pieces.


Did you know that there are over 20 different physical conditions that can show up as mental health
symptoms? You might have severe panic attacks, generalized anxiety, depression, severe mood swings,
or even auditory hallucinations caused by disorders in your body. That’s right. It’s important to
make sure your body is functioning like it should, before you start tackling mental health symptoms.


While I do provide therapy and medication management, I don’t believe it should be the goal for
everybody and for all time. I specialize in applying all missing pieces into your care. Whether it’s
your childhood experiences changing how your body responds to stress… or experiences that you’ve had
as an adult keeping you in survival mode… or how your hormones are affecting your mood… or how your
genetics are reducing the effectiveness of your medications… I go through it all. I can
also address the side effects of your medication, so you can have happier and more fulfilling
relationships. And (when the time is right) we can work towards getting you down to the lowest
medication dose possible (tapering/de-prescribing).


As your doctor, my priority is to uncover and address the hidden causes of your condition. I will
help you understand what’s taking place in your body by looking at the physical & mental conditions
that could be hindering your mental wellness. Together, we’ll make an action plan that will use all
the pieces that are important to your peace and stability using the latest specialty tests, holistic
methods, and most effective therapies for long-term healing. I aim to use the most convenient, and
most effective holistic & integrative therapies to help you feel well, happy, and hopeful again.
Let’s get started today!

## Chiropractic Care - Regulated, Evidence-Informed Healthcare

Chiropractic is a statutorily regulated healthcare profession in the UK, overseen by the General
Chiropractic Council (GCC) under the Chiropractors Act 1994. Chiropractors are primary-contact
practitioners with expertise in assessing, diagnosing, and managing musculoskeletal (MSK)
conditions, so you can access safe, evidence-informed care directly, without a referral.

Our approach is patient-centred and holistic. Each care plan is tailored to you, combining gentle
hands-on care with movement guidance, posture and ergonomic advice, and practical lifestyle
strategies. We often collaborate with GPs, physiotherapists, surgeons, and other health
professionals to support your recovery and long-term wellbeing. By combining clinical expertise with
practical, we help you restore function, prevent recurrence, and build a resilient foundation for
lifelong musculoskeletal health.

### [What is ISSUP?][145]

We are an international network that unites, connects and shares knowledge across the substance use
workforce. We aim to make the work of our members as effective as possible through knowledge
sharing, training and networking opportunities.
[ Read more about What is ISSUP? ][146]
[

### Who is ISSUP for?

][147]
ISSUP is for everyone who is doing something to address substance use in a variety of settings. This
includes health and treatment professionals, prevention practitioners, market disruption and supply,
law enforcement, policy makers, and community-led groups like youth and volunteers.
[Join ISSUP][148]

## London’s leading therapeutic Low Level Laser Clinic.

We are experts in the application of Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT). which uses non-thermal laser,
known medically as Photobiomodulation Therapy (PBMT) and more commonly as Red Light Therapy (RLT).
We combine the use of LLLT (light wavelengths in the Infrared / IR and Near Infrared / NIR range),
to provide safe, organic, efficient healing.

[Our background][65] is unique. We are pioneers in [Red Light Therapy for Fertility][66], offering
therapy for ovarian rejuvenation and reproductive health, including endometriosis and PCOS. The
[Ovarian Rejuvenation Programme][67] is developed in collaboration with expert fertility
gynaecologists, where we combine Red Light with Ovarian PRP for women of all ages. We also lead UK
and European research in [Therapeutic Laser for Hypothyroid][68], extending proven protocols from
Turkey and Brazil, to develop our own published [lower fluency protocols][69].

Our natural health service employs outstanding medical therapeutic lasers to aid the recovery of a
wide spectrum of health conditions, including [Smoking Cessation][70]. We provide PBM Therapy for
[Oral Mucositis][71], approved by [NICE, UK][72] in 2018. Similarly we lead in the development of
Low Level Laser Therapy for inflammatory brain conditions including [Autism Spectrum Disorder
][73](ASD) and [Neurodegenerative Disease][74]. We are a [Certified Melillo Method Practitioner][75]
Centre for Functional Development Behavioural Neuroimmunology, accredited by the Interdisciplinary
Association of Functional Neurosciences and Rehabilitation ([IAFNR][76]).

Our Ethos

## We believe in **more life** — more energy, more healing, more time doing what matters. MedWave
## exists to give practitioners the tools to deliver measurable, life-changing outcomes.

**Photobiomodulation** (PBM) — commonly known as **red light therapy** — uses specific wavelengths
of light to stimulate cellular energy production at the mitochondrial level. It’s not new. The
science dates back over 50 years, with peer-reviewed studies confirming its safety and efficacy
across a wide range of medical and aesthetic applications.

Our Technology

## Real Science. *Real* Results.

Ongoing pain, recurring injuries, or uncertainty about your next step can feel frustrating and

meaningful progress.

## Comprehensive Assessment

We take time to understand how your body moves, compensates, and responds, identifying the true
contributors to your symptoms.

## Conditions We Commonly Support

complex, long-standing conditions.

Care is guided by a thorough understanding of how your body is functioning, not a one-size-fits-all

The problem

## The research is right on average. You’re bio-individual.

Health studies describe the average response of a group. Your genes, gut, environment, and history
make your response different. That gap is where years of guessing live.

01

### Generic advice has a hidden failure rate

A protocol with great evidence behind it can still do nothing for you. The studies were never about
you specifically.

02

### Guessing costs more than money

The bigger price is time, energy, and attention. Months on something inert is a season of your life
you can’t refund.

03

### Your best interventions stay hidden

The thing that would work shockingly well for you might be unpopular, under-researched, or sitting
unused in your cabinet right now.

The PBM Foundation supports and coordinates scientific and clinical efforts, and raises awareness,

The PBM Foundation supports and coordinates scientific and clinical efforts, and raises awareness,
for light technology treating patients with COVID-19, cancer, chronic pain, opioid use disorder, and
neurological conditions.

## ADVOCACY

Named the 2026 Global Health Innovation Advocate of the Year, the Foundation collaborates with
scientists, practitioners, and government officials to expand acceptance and application of PBM.
This includes facilitating collaborative research, publicizing clinical evidence, and promoting
policy and programmatic changes. Foundation board members and advisors have presented to the White
House, Executive Branch Agencies, Congress, Medical and Policy Forums, and the United Nations.

**[Learn more»][65]**

[PBM Basics - knee pain]

## PBM BASICS

Learn about the science and application of Photobiomodulation (PBM), successfully treating COVID-19,
Opioid Use Disorder (OUD), and traumatic brain injury (TBI); managing pain; healing wounds;
preventing Cancer therapy’s side-effects; and helping our Military. Over 100 million patients have
received PBM in clinical settings proving PBM effective and safe.

[**Learn More»**][66]

[PBM Research]

## RESEARCH

The Foundation funds and coordinates PBM research around the world.  We share our research with
healthcare leaders and senior policy officials. Evidence of PBM’s successful treatments supports
expanding insurance coverage, treatment protocols, and order sets so patients receive the full
benefit of PBM therapy.

[**Learn More»**][67]

[PBM Education - auditorium]

## EDUCATION

The Foundation supports establishing degree and certification programs for using PBM to treat
patients. We work with medical and nursing schools to support curriculum development, learning
module design, and faculty recruitment. There are now formal medical and nursing degrees for PBM
with more to come!

[**Learn More»**][68]

Support PBM’s efforts to develop pain management alternatives to opioids using light therapy.

## Light Therapy

## A proven healing technology  for a healthy life

Photobiomodulation also known as red light therapy or low level laser therapy studies the biological
reactions to specific light wavelengths exposure. Light absorption triggers reactions at the cell
level by boosting mitochondria activity. Years of studies have shown that effects include:
* pain relief
* improved blood flow
* soft and hard tissue regeneration
* metabolism regulation

Applications are proven in fields as diverse as dentistry, oncology, diabetes, mental health and
general wellness.

As a completely natural way of healing, photobiomodulation can be used as a complement with
traditional treatments or as a substitute.

# Plasticity Brain Centers is where Brain-Body reconnection leads to Life-Changing Results

## Experience The Difference

Our patients have inspiring stories to tell about turning despair into hope, frustration into
empowerment, can't into can and disability into ability.

[Watch Patient Stories][36]
[Tami H testimonial: Son's recovery from post-concussion syndrome and dysautonomia at Plasticity
Center]
[Lauren B's 5-star Plasticity Center review: TBI recovery, symptom-free after 3 months]
[Nancy D review: Plasticity Center helped TBI recovery]

### Take a moment to watch this video and discover how our treatments can help you get back to
### living your life to the fullest.

Through targeted therapies such as vestibular rehabilitation, eye movement exercises, cognitive
training, and receptor-based brain stimulation, we promote neuroplasticity, improve brain
connectivity, and alleviate symptoms associated with Post-Concussion Syndrome, dizziness, migraines,
balance, and many other neurological challenges.

[Plasticity-brain-centers-logo]

The brain is the engine that runs the body, continuously sending signals that allow us to function.
As a society, we tend to prioritize other areas of our health but neglect our brain health. So, when
faced with an issue, the big question is, where do you go and what do you do? Plasticity Brain
Centers is a cutting-edge, rehabilitation clinic led by experienced, dedicated, patient-focused
doctors. Our doctors provide non-pharmaceutical and non-invasive brain training founded on the
concept that the brain is capable of learning and changing, with nearly limitless potential,
throughout life. This concept has been termed “neuroplasticity”. Plasticity Brain Centers can
improve the neurological performance and quality of life of patients with brain injuries and
neurological disorders.

[Our Treatment][37]

treatment plan utilizes a multitude of different well-known and leading-edge modalities and
technologies to retrain the brain.

### About Retina Consultants of Muncie

At Retina Consultants of Muncie, vitreoretinal ophthalmologist Jeffrey Rapkin, MD, provides
comprehensive eye care to people 12 and older in Muncie, Indiana, and throughout Delaware County. 

Dr. Rapkin began his professional education at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, earning his
Bachelor of Science in premedical science. After graduation, he enrolled at the Medical College of
Wisconsin in Milwaukee, obtaining his Doctor of Medicine.

Before entering private practice, Dr. Rapkin completed an internship and an ophthalmology residency
at Henry Ford Hospital in Detroit, Michigan, and a retina and vitreous surgery fellowship at the
Southern Illinois University School of Medicine in Springfield.

Dr. Rapkin has served the Muncie and Richmond communities since 1996. At Retina Consultants of
Muncie, he offers full-service treatment for diabetic retinopathy and other age-related eye
diseases.

People from all over East Central Indiana visit Dr. Rapkin for treatment of various eye conditions,
including [macular degeneration][30], [retinal detachment][31], and [floaters][32]. Dr. Rapkin also
provides more specialized care, including the treatment of [retinal vascular diseases][33] caused by
high blood pressure and circulatory issues. 

Dr. Rapkin prides himself on providing convenient and high-quality care. To ensure patient
convenience, he offers in-home monitoring of eye disease and surgical procedures at facilities in
Muncie and Anderson.

Retina Consultants of Muncie is conveniently located and accepts most health insurance, including

### About Retina Consultants of Muncie

At Retina Consultants of Muncie, vitreoretinal ophthalmologist Jeffrey Rapkin, MD, provides
comprehensive eye care to people 12 and older in Muncie, Indiana, and throughout Delaware County. 

Dr. Rapkin began his professional education at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, earning his
Bachelor of Science in premedical science. After graduation, he enrolled at the Medical College of
Wisconsin in Milwaukee, obtaining his Doctor of Medicine.

Before entering private practice, Dr. Rapkin completed an internship and an ophthalmology residency
at Henry Ford Hospital in Detroit, Michigan, and a retina and vitreous surgery fellowship at the
Southern Illinois University School of Medicine in Springfield.

Dr. Rapkin has served the Muncie and Richmond communities since 1996. At Retina Consultants of
Muncie, he offers full-service treatment for diabetic retinopathy and other age-related eye
diseases.

People from all over East Central Indiana visit Dr. Rapkin for treatment of various eye conditions,
including [macular degeneration][30], [retinal detachment][31], and [floaters][32]. Dr. Rapkin also
provides more specialized care, including the treatment of [retinal vascular diseases][33] caused by
high blood pressure and circulatory issues. 

Dr. Rapkin prides himself on providing convenient and high-quality care. To ensure patient
convenience, he offers in-home monitoring of eye disease and surgical procedures at facilities in
Muncie and Anderson.

Retina Consultants of Muncie is conveniently located and accepts most health insurance, including
Veterans Administration (VA) insurance. Many patients come from out of town to receive comprehensive
evaluation and imaging services for various eye conditions. 

Dr. Rapkin is a member and the past president of Muncie Sunrise Rotary and has served on the board
of directors of the Muncie Symphony Orchestra and the Muncie Civic Theatre. He welcomes anyone
seeking high-quality eye care to Retina Consultants of Muncie today.

To learn more, call the Retina Consultants of Muncie office or request an appointment online.
